purpose: Check on the training split, before any validation score: do reports that name only 'upper' (or only 'lower') zones have their ground-truth lesion in the upper (or lower) part of the image? The grid treats 'upper' as image rows 0-74; this has not been checked with data.
data: as configs/phase4/option1_train_rule.json: QaTa-COV19 training split; ids from lgms.data.split_ids('QaTa-COV19', 'train'), no intersection with 'val' or 'test' ids (test: id list only); masks from lgms.data.read_mask('QaTa-COV19', 'train', id); location from results/phase2_text_attributes.csv (dataset QaTa-COV19, split train), not re-parsed; every training id has exactly one row

exclusions.mask_empty: the ground-truth mask has no lesion pixel
exclusions.not_in_a_group: the report is in neither group below
exclusions.counting: each excluded report is counted once, under the first reason in this order

groups.upper_only: every side named in the location has exactly the zone 'upper' (e.g. 'left:upper', 'left:upper;right:upper'); one- or two-sided
groups.lower_only: every side named in the location has exactly the zone 'lower' (e.g. 'right:lower', 'left:lower;right:lower'); one- or two-sided
groups.not_counted: any location with 'middle', 'all', 'unspecified' or a mix of upper and lower

lesion_position.centroid_row: mean row index (0 = top) of the ground-truth lesion pixels
lesion_position.agreement: upper_only reports agree if upper; lower_only reports agree if lower

rules.1: agreement of the two groups combined >= 0.90
rules.2: agreement of upper_only >= 0.90 and agreement of lower_only >= 0.90
rules.3: upper_only and lower_only each have >= 30 reports (after the exclusions)

result.fail: rule 3 is true and rule 1 or 2 is false

descriptive_only: per group: 10% / 50% / 90% quantiles of centroid_row; median share of lesion pixels inside the stated row band (upper: rows 0-74; lower: rows 149-223)
stop_conditions: training ids overlap validation or test ids; this file changes after its commit; parse_ok false for more than 5% of the QaTa training rows; any unit test fails; any mask or text outside the training split would be needed
output: results/phase4_vertical_train_check.csv (group labels and numbers only; no text, no per-image rows)
